title: Biased probability after dropping a prefix
statement: Let $\rho\in\bbr$, let $s,n$ be natural numbers, and let $P$ be a predicate on Boolean words. The biased probability that $P$ holds of the word obtained by dropping the first $s$ bits of a length-$(s+n)$ sampled word equals the biased probability that $P$ holds of a length-$n$ sampled word.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a predicate on Boolean words
